name: [🍪27.5 + SUMO COLLAB🍪] Anime Guardians
desc:
[ Welcome to Anime Guardians! ⚔️✨]

😈 Summon powerful anime heroes from across the multiverse to stand against endless waves of enemies!
💎 Upgrade, evolve, and awaken your units to unleash devastating abilities and dominate the battlefield!
🏆 Collect rare and legendary units from epic raids, challenging towers, and competitive leaderboards!
🌌 Join forces with friends and lead your army through exciting game modes, multiverse battles, and boss challenges!
🔥 The fate of the world rests in your hands—will you rise as the ultimate Guardian Commander?

☄️ GATE: spawn every 20 minutes and auto starting in 60 sec
